751970102.text: Ah, I was hoping you'd swing by. Yes, about those Dragonteeth... Oh, I see you've already finished gathering them up.

751970103.text: When you were off exploring, I ended up hitting a slight snag over here... No matter what I hit this Dragontooth with, I simply cannot take so much as a sliver off of it.

751970104.text: I've never seen anything like this before, so I had someone talk to Mr. Albedo to see how we should deal with these materials.

751970105.text: And so, if you look over yonder, you'll see that Mr. Albedo had Miss Sucrose send over a Runestone. It's right on the Alchemist's Crafting Bench.

751970106.text: A Runestone? What's that got to do with our Dragonteeth?

751970107.text: Well, according to what Miss Sucrose relayed to us from Mr. Albedo, we need to give the material some special treatment before we can use it to forge weapons.

751970108.text: One of said methods is to have one Dragontooth absorb dragon-related "vitality," then used the vitalized Dragontooth to treat other Dragonteeth.

751970109.text: As for what Miss Sucrose said about the Runestone... Ah, yes, she said it was "a relic left to the Knights of Favonius by a wandering troupe that helped Mondstadt rebel against the old nobility a thousand years ago."

751970110.text: The flautist of that troupe once fought against a monster known as "Bakunawa" in the Mare Jivari. This Runestone was carved from its body...

751970111.text: Eh? Wait a sec, if Paimon's memory isn't failing her, didn't Citlali tell us that the Mare Jivari was created by Sanhaj's battle with the Abyss... five hundred years ago?

751970112.text: Are we sure the troupe's story is from a thousand years back?

751970113.text: Haha, how could it be mistaken? That wandering troupe's story of heroism has long since been recorded in the "History of Kings and Clans."

751970114.text: Anyway, Mr. Albedo said that this Runestone contains "infinite vitality," similar to that of a dragon.

751970115.text: All you need to do is use the Crafting Bench to absorb the vitality of the Runestone with the Dragontooth, then we can get to forging our weapons.

751970116.text: That sounds impressive... as expected of Albedo...

751970118.text: #Yeah! If not for him, we'd be totally stuck... Anyway, {NICKNAME}, let's try absorbing the Runestone's power!

751970120.text: Haha, that's great! Here — you take this Dragontooth, and I'll leave that whole side of things to you.

751970121.text: Alchemy's truly something else, huh... How does one even absorb "vitality" from a thousand year-old stone?

751970501.text: There, it's done! Haha! Here, hold that. How does it feel?

751970502.text: How much do I owe you?

751970503.text: Oh, don't worry about paying for it. The chance to work with these materials was a rare pleasure. No need to bring Mora into it.

751970504.text: Alright. I'd say this weapon is ready for an adventure, wouldn't you? I hope you'll take good care of it.
